donate.title: Donate goods
donate.heading:
A box of rice, a school uniform —
straight to a family in Yuen Long.
donate.lead: We collect food, daily necessities and new school uniforms and take them directly to low-income families in Yuen Long. Contact us before donating so we can confirm what is needed now and how to hand it over.
donate.need1Desc: Unopened rice, cooking oil, canned food and noodles.
donate.need2Desc: Detergent, cleaning supplies, tissues and personal hygiene items.
donate.need3Desc: Unused uniforms, school bags and stationery.
donate.need4Desc: Healthy food and everyday essentials for our distribution days.
donate.step1Desc: Tell us on WhatsApp or by email what you have and roughly how much.
donate.step2Desc: We confirm whether it is needed now and how to hand it over.
donate.step3Desc: Bring it to the office at the agreed time, or follow the arrangement we suggest.
donate.note1: Food must be unopened with at least three months before its expiry date.
donate.note2: Uniforms, stationery and hygiene items should be new and unused.
donate.note3: We cannot accept opened food, expired items or second-hand clothing.
donate.note4: For a large quantity, contact us first so we can arrange help to receive it.
donate.hoursNote: Closed on public holidays. Please WhatsApp or call before dropping anything off.
donate.ctaTitle: Got something to give? Tell us first.
donate.ctaLead: We usually reply within one working day.
